name: @mstar-harness/cli
description: Morning Star harness CLI — installer bootstrap, canonical command adapter, and stdio MCP server.

scripts.build: bun run scripts/build-web.ts && bun run --cwd ../commands build && rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --target node --outfile dist/mstar-harness.js && bun ../../scripts/escape-dist-literals.ts dist/mstar-harness.js
scripts.typecheck:src: bun run scripts/build-web.ts && bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun run --cwd ../engine build && bun run build && bun test
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun run check
